name: effect-ink-reveal
title: Ink Reveal
description: Bốn vết mực mềm loang ra từ bốn điểm lệch giờ nhau, viền gợn rồi nhập lại thành một, lộ trọn hình bên dưới.

moworks.author: takayu

options.size: end radius as a share of the width (0.55)
options.wobble: ± share of the radius, fading as it grows (0.14)
options.exitAt: s after the start to fade (null)

credit.author: TakayuStudio (motion-reference)
credit.licence: No licence stated: idea and numbers only
credit.madeNote: written here from the idea and its numbers; none of the source's code

moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio ink-reveal, written here): Four soft blobs mask the target (demo box 200 x 110), centres at (24 %, 60 %), (55 %, 29 %), (78 %, 60 %), (44 %, 83 %) of the box, starting 0 / 250 / 150 / 500 ms; each radius 0 -> 110 px (0.55 x box width) over 1200 ms easeOutCubic; 2.5 px feather, edge wobble +-14 % of radius fading as it grows; blobs merge into a full reveal. Exit: fade 300 ms ease-in cubic. Recipe: 980 ms, r 0 -> 105 px. Params: duration mỗi vết (1.2 s) · points (4) · wobble (14 %) · feather (2.5 px).
moworks.titleVi: Mực loang lộ hình từ bốn điểm
